items.title: Eric Brown Interview, 1969-10-26
items.q: The interviewee (Eric Brown) is the interviewer in this transcript, not the interviewee. He mentions Len Bernard as the performer of a track and lists him as the drummer in a band, but there is no personal interaction or relationship described between Eric Brown and Len Bernard.

ctx.x: The End Cushion foot stomp, that's the Clarence Williams composition played for us by Len Bernard. And that's issued on Swaggy S1221, 12-inch LP. Eric, what's the story on Swaggy? First of all, what is Swaggy? That's a colloquial term, isn't it?

Yeah, well, Swaggy is the local term for a, I suppose you call him a bum here, but there's a person that travels around from town to town, making a living where he can, carrying a pack on his back, which is usually all his worldly belongings rolled up in a blanket. And this is called a swag. It's called an app by Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland…
